A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same HEPi research work. The main text, figures, tables, equations and Appendices A–E support reliable comparison; v5 also contains six readable appended pages.

before.justification: v1 reports original reinforcement-learning simulations on seven manipulation tasks, including comparative learning curves, generalization tests and appendix ablations.

after.justification: v5 retains these original simulation results, including the main evaluations and Appendix D analyses.

M1.justification: The PONITA backbone, heterogeneous message-passing updates, DeepSets critic, inputs/actions and TRPL training remain unchanged. Section 3.1 expands the convolutional explanation, and the final page formalizes previously described projections without specifying a different procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same seven tasks, rigid-object sets, unseen geometries, mesh resolutions, noise conditions and cloth-orientation scenarios. The appended pages introduce no additional evaluated coverage.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain EMPN and Transformer, HeteroGNN and GNN for cloth experiments, attention variants, locally connected actuator variants, and PPO versus TRPL. The repeated cloth plot uses the existing comparator set.

E3.justification: The 1000 evaluation scenes per task, undiscounted-return metric, object training/test partitions, preprocessing and experimental budgets are retained. Appendix E reports unchanged model configurations, hyperparameters and PPO tuning procedures.

E4.justification: Noise/resolution robustness, unseen-object generalization, cloth sample-space analyses, attention and training-stability studies, and graph-neighborhood, depth and orientation-discretization ablations are unchanged. The additional cloth plot repeats Figure 20.

E5.justification: Both versions report main results over 10 seeds using IQM and 95% confidence intervals. The appendix retains its experiment-specific 5- and 8-seed reporting and the same PPO search/validation seed counts.

E6.justification: The learning curves, Figure 5 numerical heatmaps and generalization results, Appendix D ablations and Table 2 training times are unchanged. The plot on v5 PDF page 35 redisplays existing Figure 20 results.

T1.justification: v5 adds a stated MPNN sensitivity bound and a formal MDP homomorphism definition on PDF pages 31–32. Section 3.1 also newly asserts preservation of universal approximation. Proposition 3.1 and its Appendix A proof remain unchanged; the appended copies of that proposition and the equivariance definition add no new proof.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same benchmark and HEPi contributions, with the same claims about returns, sample efficiency and generalization. The abstract's project-page sentence does not change the scientific contribution claims.

C2.justification: Section 3.1 now asserts that efficient kernel factorization preserves universal approximation, adding an expressiveness argument to v1's efficiency discussion. Empirical interpretations and limitations concerning robot-body abstraction, available keypoints and approximate equivariance remain unchanged.

D1.justification: The final page explicitly writes the separate mean and covariance projection problems previously described in prose. The abstract adds a project-page pointer, but 'here' has no active hyperlink or printed destination in the supplied v5 PDF. Appendix E's implementation and hardware details remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The bibliography and research positioning in Section 5 and Appendix A are unchanged. However, the newly appended sensitivity bound and homomorphism definition carry unresolved '?' citations, preventing determination of whether their intended sources are existing or additional cited works.

P1.justification: v5 locally rewrites Section 3.1, refines symmetry terminology in Section 2, expands acknowledgments and adds the project-page sentence. The established section and appendix order remains intact; the additional standalone pages are not integrated into that narrative.

P2.justification: Existing figures and tables retain their layouts. v5 reflows some equations and appends colored mathematical boxes plus a duplicate Figure 20 labeled Figure 1 with expanded panel labels. These pages restart pagination, and v5 loses the bookmarks and active links present in v1.

improvement.justification: v5 clarifies Section 3.1 and adds limited formal background. However, the appended material includes unresolved citations, disconnected boxes and duplicated material under restarted numbering. Losing bookmarks and active links also reduces usability, while the new project-page pointer supplies no usable destination. These editorial regressions outweigh the limited explanatory gains; the experiments and central proof remain intact.
